$comment: Closed vocabulary of the Auvyx storefront design system (spec §11). Sorted keys. Edited by one task at a time.

accordion.summary: <details> tile: 56px summary with a chevron that turns when open; body below. Sets the fill context to the sheet.

align.summary: Flex and grid alignment; one axis per class.

avatar.summary: A person's initial on the accent (or an img inside), round, thumb-m size.

board.summary: One featured product in the middle of four: four columns with the first product spanning the two centre columns and both rows; under 44rem of its own width two columns with the featured product across the first row. In home.css, after the core.

brands.summary: Grid of brand logo links: inline SVG wordmarks in currentColor, muted until hover.

breadcrumb.summary: Trail of links with / separators drawn by CSS; the current page in the text colour, the links muted (it sits on the page); links keep a 44px hit area.

btn.summary: Pill action. Default = brand action colour; soft reads the fill context.

hooks.data-auvyx-buy-now: product: adds the chosen product and goes to the checkout
hooks.data-auvyx-product-root: swatches, cart-drawer: the element that holds a product's options, price, quantity and add button

buybar.summary: Quantity stepper and the main add button; the button fills the row and wraps below the stepper under 10rem.

hooks.data-auvyx-cart-empty: cart-drawer: the empty state; hidden is removed when the cart is empty
hooks.data-auvyx-cart-lines: cart-drawer: renders the lines into this list
hooks.data-auvyx-qty: cart-drawer: changes the line quantity by the value (-1 or 1)
hooks.data-auvyx-remove: cart-drawer, compare: removes the line or product

cart-line.summary: Cart row: thumbnail across two rows, title (44px hit area), options, price, then the stepper and remove.

cart-table.summary: Checkout bag as a table: a header (product, price, quantity, total) and a hairline-separated row per line; the product cell reuses the cart line's picture, title and options. Under 42rem (@container) the header goes and each row stacks: product, then price, quantity and total.

center.summary: Centred column with a measure; full width in a flex parent.

check.summary: Label row with a custom checkbox or radio input (auvyx-sf-check-box).

chip.summary: Toggle filter; pressed = action fill with a check.

choice.summary: Option tile (storage, plan); pressed = sheet with a 2px ring.

cluster.summary: Wrapping row with gap; --nowrap keeps one row and lets children shrink.

color.summary: Surface and text colour from semantic tokens; no raw colours.

hooks.data-auvyx-compare-empty: compare: the empty state, hidden while the table shows
hooks.data-auvyx-compare-root: compare: renders the table into this element
hooks.data-auvyx-compare-wrap: compare: the table's wrapper, hidden while the list is empty

compare-table.summary: Horizontal scroller with a sticky key column; rows whose values are all equal are muted.

container.summary: Page width with fluid gutter, centred.

hooks.data-auvyx-count: cart-drawer, wishlist, compare: writes the count (value = cart, wishlist or compare)

count.summary: 18px count badge at the top end of an icon button.

hooks.data-auvyx-unit: countdown: writes the value of this unit (d, h, m or s)

countdown.summary: Deal timer: unit tiles with tabular digits; role=timer with an aria-label the island refreshes every minute.

hooks.data-auvyx-close: every island: closes the nearest dialog
hooks.data-auvyx-open: on any button: opens the dialog whose data-auvyx-panel has this name and sets aria-expanded
hooks.data-auvyx-panel: cart-drawer, mobile-menu, filters: names this dialog; the island calls showModal()

drawer.summary: Side sheet on a native <dialog> (default end; --start, --bottom). Scrim and blur on ::backdrop, slides in with @starting-style; head and foot stay, the body scrolls.

empty.summary: Centred empty state: icon tile, title, text, action.

hooks.data-auvyx-fbt: fbt: the root; its checked items (auvyx-sf-check inputs with data-auvyx-fbt-item) are summed into the total and added in one request
hooks.data-auvyx-fbt-count: fbt: the 'N items' line the island keeps in step with the checked items
hooks.data-auvyx-fbt-add: fbt: adds every checked item, then opens the cart
hooks.data-auvyx-fbt-item: fbt: one item's check box, with the product id as its value and data-amount its price
hooks.data-auvyx-fbt-total: fbt: the total the island keeps in step with the checked items

fbt.summary: Frequently bought together: pictures joined by plus signs and a check list on the left; a compact tile with the total, the item count and one add button on the right (stacked when narrow).

feature.summary: Feature tile: an icon tile, a title and a muted text; sets the fill context to the sheet.

field.summary: Label, control and hint or error, stacked.

hooks.data-auvyx-facet: filters: writes the option's result count (value = facet:key)
hooks.data-auvyx-filters: filters: the <form> whose changes re-query the results

filter.summary: Facet group on <details>: a 44px summary with a chevron, then auvyx-sf-check options with tabular counts at the end.

footer.summary: Footer sheet: link columns (auto-fill) and a bottom row; links are 44px rows.

hooks.data-auvyx-gallery-main: gallery: swaps the image; sets data-state=zoom and --auvyx-sf-gallery-x/-y (the zoom origin)
hooks.data-auvyx-lightbox: gallery: the lightbox dialog (auvyx-sf-lightbox); the main image, a slide and View larger open it at the image on show
hooks.data-auvyx-nozoom: gallery: no hover zoom on this gallery

gallery.summary: Product pictures: one main image with thumbnails at the inline start, below or inside it, or every image at once as a grid, a stack or a reel; a narrow gallery puts its thumbs in a row and turns a grid or stack into a reel.

gap.summary: Gap on any flex or grid parent; token steps only.

grid.summary: Auto-fill grid; columns never narrower than --auvyx-sf-min.

hooks.data-auvyx-disclosure: navigation: a native details disclosure with a stable summary aria-controls and panel id
hooks.data-auvyx-hover: navigation: opt-in additive hover on fine mouse pointers; click and keyboard still work
hooks.data-auvyx-pinned: navigation: home category root; its open state reserves the frame's home rail, independently of submenu presentation
hooks.data-auvyx-mobile-menu: navigation: native mobile details fallback, kept until its content can move into the named dialog
hooks.data-auvyx-mobile-content: navigation: one mobile menu tree, moved (never cloned) from fallback into the drawer

header.summary: Legacy sticky glass header, plus opt-in commerce rows sharing the category/logo rail. Commerce collapses strictly below 900px. Native details keep menu links available without JavaScript; navigation enhances one active submenu path and mobile dialog after boot.

hero.summary: Centred hero (at most 40rem, inline padding): trust row, title, text, meta row and a search. Under 34rem (@container) the meta row stacks and its separators hide. Text colour throughout: it sits on the page glow.

histogram.summary: Rating distribution: one row per star value; the fill width is --auvyx-sf-progress (0..1, data).

home-tiles.summary: The home page's promo tiles: four equal columns across the column (two when the row is narrow, one on a phone), each tile a auvyx-sf-promo with copy only. Under a header that pins its department menu the section keeps a full section gap below that panel.

icon.summary: Lucide icon from the sprite; paint from CSS.

input.summary: Input wrapper: owns border and focus; holds a control, icons, or a trailing button (--pill).

layers.summary: Stack children in one grid cell; place with self-alignment utilities.

states: disabled (zoom and step buttons at their ends)

hooks.data-auvyx-lightbox-count: gallery: the n / N line, kept in step
hooks.data-auvyx-lightbox-retry: gallery: loads the picture on show again
hooks.data-auvyx-lightbox-slide: gallery: one picture or the video; the one on show has data-state=current
hooks.data-auvyx-lightbox-stage: gallery: where the picture shows; wheel, double click, pinch zoom it, a drag pans it, a swipe steps, a click on the empty stage closes
hooks.data-auvyx-lightbox-step: gallery: shows the previous (-1) or next (1) picture
hooks.data-auvyx-lightbox-zoom: gallery: in, out or reset (the 100% button shows the zoom)

lightbox.summary: A product's pictures full screen, one at a time, in a auvyx-sf-modal--full: a bar with the title, the count, zoom and Close; the stage; previous and next over it; a row of thumbnails. Arrows, Home/End and + − 0 work from the keyboard; zoom goes up to 4×.

link.summary: Inline text link: accent underline on hover, ring on focus.

listing.summary: The shop listing layout on the auvyx-sf-sidebar composition: the filters dialog (auvyx-sf-listing-filters) docked as the side column while the container fits it (@container 48rem) and the Filters button toggles it in place; below that, and on a closed panel, it is the filters drawer and the results take the full width. In listing.css, after the core, on shop, category and brand pages.

logo.summary: Brand link: mark and wordmark, at least 44px tall. A long wordmark truncates with an ellipsis.

hooks.data-auvyx-fab: mobile-menu: sets data-state=compact on this button while the page scrolls down
hooks.data-auvyx-open: mobile-menu: opens the dialog whose data-auvyx-panel is menu

menu-fab.summary: 56px floating menu button at the bottom end, safe-area aware, below 900px only. With several menus it opens one drawer with a section per menu (no bottom dock).

menu-item.summary: 44px row in a menu, drawer or result list: icon or thumbnail, label (truncates), meta.

hooks.data-auvyx-results: live-search: renders auvyx-sf-menu-item rows (role=option, aria-selected) into this list

menu-list.summary: Vertical list of auvyx-sf-menu-item rows; resets its own list styles.

meta.summary: Product facts as a <dl>: a muted label and its value on each line (SKU, categories, tags).

hooks.data-auvyx-address-form: addresses: the address dialog's form; it fills it, saves it with address.save and draws the page again
hooks.data-auvyx-address-title: addresses: the dialog's title, Add an address or Edit address
hooks.data-auvyx-quick-modal: quick-view: renders the product into the body and calls showModal()
hooks.data-auvyx-search-status: live-search: announces loading, empty and failed searches

modal.summary: Centred dialog (quick view, confirmations); --search places a narrower panel near the top; --wide is the 360° view; --full fills the window (the lightbox); the body scrolls.

newsletter.summary: Sign-up band on accent-soft: copy and a pill input with a button; the form wraps under the copy when narrow.

offer-list.summary: A product's offers as a list, each with an accent tag icon.

padding.summary: Padding on all, inline or block sides; token steps plus sheet and tile padding.

pagination.summary: 44px page links; the current page is filled with the action colour; arrows flip in RTL.

pdp.summary: The top of a product page: pictures, details and a framed buy column in one of five frames (classic and stack are the default; buybox, carousel and full are modifiers; tile tints it). Wraps to one column under 48rem of its own width.

perk.summary: Small tile: accent icon, title and meta (delivery, returns).

pills.summary: Row of pills; scrolls horizontally; pads so pill hit areas are not clipped.

popover.summary: [popover] sheet under the header at the inline end (menus, the search sheet); --wide for search. Fades in with @starting-style.

hooks.data-auvyx-price: swatches: replaces the content with the selected variant's price

price.summary: Current price and the struck-through old price (muted, never subtle); --lg on the product page.

states: data-view=compact (on the auvyx-sf-grid: rows in as many columns as fit)
data-view=rows (on the auvyx-sf-grid: four columns, two in a narrow panel, whole rows)

hooks.data-auvyx-recent-grid: recent: the grid the recently viewed island fills with cards
hooks.data-auvyx-add: cart-drawer: adds the product (value = product id) and opens the cart
hooks.data-auvyx-quickview: quick-view: opens the quick-view modal for this product
hooks.data-auvyx-wishlist: wishlist: toggles aria-pressed on every button for this product

product-card.summary: Tile card: square media, overlay tags and save button, brand, a 2-line title with a 44px hit area, rating, price row. Sets the fill context to the sheet. data-view=list on the grid makes rows.

promo.summary: Banner card: copy at the start; the art sits at the bottom end and bleeds by transform inside the clip; auvyx-sf-promo-photo instead is a photo with its own background: it fills the end of the card (--auvyx-sf-promo-photo) and fades into the card toward the copy (--auvyx-sf-promo-fade); under 24rem (@container) the art or photo moves below the copy. Colour: auvyx-sf-bg-promo-* on the root, auvyx-sf-tone-* on the copy (a tone on the root would recolour its own focus ring).

prose.summary: CMS HTML (descriptions, posts): the only block with type selectors and flow spacing.

hooks.data-auvyx-qty: cart-drawer: changes the quantity by the value (-1 or 1)
hooks.data-auvyx-qty-root: cart-drawer: the quantity the add button reads

qty.summary: Quantity stepper: two icon buttons and a value.

rating.summary: Stars in the rating colour and a muted value; role=img with the sentence in aria-label.

hooks.data-auvyx-review-list: forms: prepends a newly submitted (pending) review to this list

review.summary: Review tile: author, stars, date, title, text, and a Verified buyer tag for paid orders.

row-tile.summary: Category row, used as auvyx-sf-tile auvyx-sf-tile--link auvyx-sf-row-tile: thumbnail, title and meta, chevron (auvyx-sf-tile-icon). Replaces the spike's 8-class row.

search.summary: Large pill search with icon, control and button.

search-trigger.summary: Field-like button opening the native product search dialog; desktop shortcut keycap.

section-head.summary: Section title (and text) with actions at the end; wraps when there is no room.

select.summary: Customisable select (appearance: base-select): styled closed control and picker; OS picker only where base-select is unsupported.

shape.summary: Corner radius per role, shadows and clipping; corner-shape refines where supported.

sheet.summary: White page section: stack, sheet padding and gap, sheet radius; sets fill context to tile.

hooks.data-auvyx-view: filters: grid or list (aria-pressed); sets data-view on the results grid

shop-bar.summary: Toolbar above a product grid: count, sort, view switch and the mobile Filters button; wraps.

states: data-rail=header (on the grid: no list of its own; where the header pins its menu the hero takes the second column)
showcase.summary: The home's hero row: a list of departments (auvyx-sf-tile) beside the hero slider. The departments take the commerce rail's width and step aside (visibility) where the header pins its own category panel; under 50rem of the row's own width they go and the slider has the row. In home.css, after the core.

sidebar.summary: Two children: sidebar of --auvyx-sf-side, main grows; wraps under 50 %.

size.summary: Growth, width, visibility and screen-reader-only text.

skeleton.summary: Loading placeholder with a shimmer; static under reduced motion.

hooks.data-auvyx-slider-nav: slider: the controls, hidden until the island runs
hooks.data-auvyx-slide-step: slider: moves by the value (-1 or 1) slides
hooks.data-auvyx-slide-to: slider: goes to the slide at this index (the dot)
hooks.data-auvyx-slides: slider: the snap scroller holding the slides

slider.summary: Slides in a snap scroller (swipe and scroll work without JavaScript); the slider island adds previous/next buttons and dots (44px targets), and for --hero turns itself every few seconds unless reduced motion, hover or focus says no. --hero sets the promo height of its slides, --cards sizes the slides as product cards. In home.css, after the core.

spec-table.summary: Key and value rows with hairlines (inset shadows); one table per spec group.

hooks.data-auvyx-spin: spin: the stage; data-frames is its frames (JSON), the island turns through them
hooks.data-auvyx-spin-step: spin: turns by the value (-1 or 1)

spin.summary: A 360° view: one frame of a turning product on a tile; drag, the arrow keys or the turn buttons change the frame. Without JavaScript the first frame shows.

spinner.summary: Inline spinner; role=status with a label.

hooks.data-auvyx-track-result: order-track: renders the steps into this element

steps.summary: Vertical timeline (order tracking, checkout): done, current and upcoming steps joined by a line; icons in the markers, no text.

hooks.data-auvyx-sticky-buy: product: shows the bar (data-state=shown) while the buy box is out of view

sticky-buy.summary: A bar along the bottom of the viewport with the product's name, price and add button while the buy box is scrolled away; never shown without JavaScript.

sticky-side.summary: A page's side column (the account's menu) that stays just under the sticky header while the page scrolls; below 900px it scrolls with the page.

stock.summary: How many are left: a line of text and a bar whose fill is --auvyx-sf-progress (0..1, data); low turns the fill to the sale ink.

hooks.data-auvyx-checkout: cart-drawer: the checkout link (aria-disabled while the cart is empty)

summary.summary: Order summary (<dl>): label and value rows; the total row is larger with a hairline above.

hooks.data-auvyx-option: swatches: an option group (value = attribute key)
hooks.data-auvyx-option-value: swatches: writes the label of the selected value

switch.summary: On/off switch on an input type=checkbox role=switch.

switcher.summary: All side by side above the threshold, all stacked below, never in between.

states: :focus-visible on the action rings the row
table.summary: Data rows with hairlines in a horizontal scroller; one action per row covers the row (opens a dialog); optional cells hide when the table is narrow.

tabs.summary: A auvyx-sf-pills tablist above its panels. Without JavaScript every panel shows; the tabs island hides the others.

tag.summary: Small pill label; at most 3 per card.

textarea.summary: Multi-line text; same look as auvyx-sf-input.

hooks.data-auvyx-address: addresses: the saved address (its JSON) a tile shows, read to fill the edit form
hooks.data-auvyx-address-default: addresses: makes this address the default (address.save with isDefault)
hooks.data-auvyx-address-delete: addresses: deletes this address (address.delete) after a confirmation
hooks.data-auvyx-address-edit: addresses: opens the address dialog for this address, or empty to add one
hooks.data-auvyx-account-panel: account-nav: the server-rendered active account domain, replaced on same-origin navigation

tile.summary: Filled surface on a sheet; --link adds hover and press; sets fill context to sheet.

toast.summary: Action-colour pill message; re-assigns fill context so a soft button reads on it.

tone.summary: Subtree on a coloured surface: re-assigns tier-1 inputs; derived tokens recompute.

trust.summary: Centred row of reassurance items with accent icons; text colour, because it sits on the page.

type.summary: Type scale, weight, text alignment and truncation.
